items.text: Schemers can be Ambassadors and Chancellors in addition to Spymasters and Agents
Added new City Site Number game option choice - 6 per player
Added new player UI option 'High contrast Player Colors'
Schemers can be Ambassadors and Chancellors in addition to Spymasters and Agents
Priest specialists increase happiness by 1/2/3 (from 1/1.5/2) and religion opinion by 2/4/6 (from 1/2/3)
Bishop specialists increase religion opinion by 3/6/9 (from 1/2/3)
In team games where one player has a tribal alliance, tribes are less likely to demand tribute from non-allied teammates
Killing or hiring a tribe unit no longer immediately changes the number of turns until the next tribe unit spawns from the closest site
Luxury resources are now more common on randomly generated maps
The more expensive (350+ science cost) Courtier bonus card techs give two Courtiers instead of one
Changed Tribe unit cooldown behavior to be consistent with player units
Tribe units receive a 2-turn cooldown if acting on another players turn (was 1)
Tribe units cooldowns are processed (reduced) before unit movement, not after
Tribe units Stun cooldown becomes Attacked cooldown on turn end
Immobile cooldown gets converted to Attacked at the end of the unit's turn, similar to what happens with Stunned
Increased tiers of later religion (Christianity, Manichaeism, Buddhism) disciple ambitions
Removed repair improvements ambitions
In the Barbarian Horde scenario, the Huns are no longer organized
Carved Ivory (Aksum) is now a Precious Resource (Wrath of Gods)
Huns won't ask for tribute before turn 20 or repeat demands until at least 10 turns after first being met (Empires of the Indus)
Added missing event for completing the Buddhist holy site (Empires of the Indus)
Improved AI character selection for governors and generals
Added tech path history to saves. Not shown in-game, for use by community save analyzers
Added new City Site Number game option choice - 6 per player
Added new player UI option 'High contrast Player Colors'
Added modsets functionality to mods screen, to allow grouping mods that can all be enabled at once
Added All Player filter to Map Search
Map Search can now be closed by clicking any top tab, in addition to clicking the Map Search icon
Updated Luxuries concept/link text to list all luxuries dynamically
Added succession to Upgrade Character text
Renamed Game option 'No Organized Tribes' to 'Disable Organized Tribes'
Text localization updates
Repair recommendation no longer always assumes buying goods, instead depends on ALT
Modifier signs for negative yields are no longer reversed
Increased visibility of attack range outline for ranged units
Added Urban to map pin options
Luxury/source helptext improvements
Updated Discord channel helptext on MP join screen
Added Disable SRP Batcher troubleshooting option
Fixed missing holy city icons on city widget
Fixed screen visibility lag after history screen has been opened
Fixed MP serialization errors that result in ghost units and repeated animations
Fixed event kills not advancing/routing when they should
Fixed units being valid to convert to a different owner if the unit is on its own city or settlement
Fixed consistency for yield help text with negative multipliers
Fixed team color on mines
Fixed repair recommendations always showing as dimmed
Fixed tooltips remaining frozen when switching screens
Fixed yield previews showing for invalid tiles with Current Tile or General filters selected
Fixed event cycling while bonus placement is active
Fixed popup processing after surrendering
Japanese text localization fixes
Fixed Korean decimal & thousands separator

Fixed terrain sometimes not updating after closing timeline
Fixed tribal stun and immobilize in Simultaneous and Loose turn styles
Fixed AZERTY keyboard shortcut issues

Fixed duplicate floating text in some cases
Fixed Buy Yields text on Road ping tooltip
Fixed resource overlay and harvested icons overlaying each other when both are present
Fixed unit widget healthbars rendering behind resource overlay
Fixed character portrait interpolation settings (Tamil Male 05 and Rome Female 11)
Fixed Rise of Carthage scenario 1 goals potentially not triggering when Tribe Level set to Weak/Passive
Fixed possible portrait duplication in Rise of Carthage Game One scenario
Fixed score list for The Hill scenario
Fixed occurrences still affecting tiles after they became invalid for it i.e. Wildfire on water (Wrath of Gods)
Fixed occurrences that reduce vegetation pillaging and destroying improvements by that mechanic (Wrath of Gods)
Fixed some missing source improvement / project lists (affects mods)
Fixed UI fragment modding with Remove tags
Text and event fixes

items.text: Changes to Religion founding requirements
Improvements to Influence Mission events with negative outcomes
Fixed memory leak
Christianity no longer has a tech requirement
Manichaeism requires Metaphysics instead of Monasticism
Tweaked Influence Mission events with negative outcomes to be better or rarer
Tile buying costs increase slightly slower and more discretely
Minor Cities now count as urban improvements (relevant for ambitions)
Drought no longer creates sand tiles, minimum duration reduced from 3 to 2 turns (Wrath of Gods)
DOTA mapscript now has a path width option (Empires of the Indus)
DOTA mapscript Separating Terrain choice split into Inner and Outer Terrain, random option added (Empires of the Indus)
Fixed memory leak caused by renderer per-frame allocations
AI avoids building non-Settler growth units from cities that have zero citizens
Landmark discovery notification added even if popup is shown
When a character mission (eg Imprison) can't be started due to a blocking memory, turns left until the memory will be removed are now shown
Updated law prerequisite event helptext to be clearer
Trait effects on city effects are not listed in a neutral tile tooltip text unless the player has a character with that trait i.e. camp effect from the Butcher's Mask
Yields from military units in territory are always shown in help text, even if there is no military unit present i.e. Happiness from Walls
Only player owned occurrence-affected tiles are listed in the turn summary. All visible tiles are still listed in the turn notifications
Tribal Invasion bonus & concept helptext now mention that war will be declared as well
Improvement pings are cleared when making tiles urban
Points to victory no longer shown when points victory is inactive
Fixed Huns appearing near player starts
Fixed units without harvest animations playing broken animations when cutting trees
Fixed observer mode visibility after observed player surrender
Fixed event predicates failing in Japanese and Chinese due to use of localized commas
Fixed bug where wrong city is sometimes selected in bonuses
Fixed lighting regression for standard shader
Fixed dune display on Sand Hill tiles
Fixed Hovel Ruins floor rendering incorrectly
Fixed black circle in city widget religion list
Fixed tech tree button behavior
Fixed unit occlusion issues with city widget religion icons
Fixed map editor null reference errors
Fixed governor rating-affected yield showing wrong value if net yield is negative
Fixed some color issues on events with 'not' requirements
Fixed some help text for improvements in team territory
Fixed settings indicating mirror map when that option is invalid for the map script
Fixed FFA achievement triggering with 2 players
Fixed Ruthless AI not taking Time Victory condition into account
Fixed Buddhist/Hindu religious improvements being referenced in Tech helptext in Wrath of Gods scenario
Fixed volcano occurrence not showing when it first appears in MP games (Wrath of Gods)
Fixed Buddhist Disciple and Hindu Brahmin vision ranges (Empires of the Indus)
Fixed invalid resource tiles on Indus Valley Duel premade map (Empires of the Indus)
AI fixes
Text and event fixes
2nd tier tech costs increased to 160 (from 150)
Moved Free Horseman tech bonus card to Coinage (from Land Consolidation)
Improvement wood cost reductions - Harbor: 40 (was 60), Market: 60 (was 80), Grocer: 80 (was 100), Fair 100 (was 120)
Winning at a difficulty gives the achievements for that level and lower. Hardcore now gives all difficulty achievements
Rebels no longer attack your teammates, unless there is nothing better for them to do
Barbarian units of settlements that have been converted to named tribes are converted to raiders, if possible
Critical hit chance is now rolled only at the beginning of the turn or after an attack
Initial leader death immunity changed to 30 turns on Lengthy Mortality and 10 turns on Realistic Mortality (from always being 20 turns)

Moved some AI functionality from Ruthless AI to Competitive AI Aggression Level: Stealing Cities and Sites being attacked by other players, shorter grace period before building Wonders, founding Religions or claiming vacant City Sites near other players, not accepting Truce when about to capture a City
Ruthless AI now just gives opinion penalty towards the player when they are close to victory or in a strong alliance
Reduced frequency of 1-tile-wide inland mountain passes, most are now increased to a width of 2
Tight turn style now prevents all actions with military units when not your turn (instead of just preventing attack and movement)
Invested tech progress is reimbursed when a player receives the tech for free
Eagle Eye promotion now available to range 1 units that don't have a fixed range (Persian Unique Units)
Builder workers can no longer stack inside a teammates territory
Removed citizen loss from base-game Plague (Wrath of Gods)
Removed marsh tiles from DOTA maps (Empires of the Indus)
Jungle can no longer be cut outside of city territory (Empires of the Indus)
Lumbermills on Ebony give as much Wood as they do on trees (Empires of the Indus)
Organized tribes (The Huns) are placed farther away from human starts and their settlements are mirrored in mirror maps (Empires of the Indus)
Charge (Yuezhi Unique Unit ability) is now only blocked by Improvements or Vegetation, not terrain type (Empires of the Indus)
Tamilakam Supremacy change now gives XP to the new leader and makes them Royal (Empires of the Indus)
The number of Rebels for avoiding a change in Supremacy now depends on culture level of family seat (Empires of the Indus)
Significant improvements to late game worker recommendation lag
AI performance optimizations
Minor Unity update to 6000.3.15f1
Increased range that AI can anchor ships to bridge lands from 10 to 20 tiles
Improved AI anchoring
Initial leader death immunity turns moved to mortality.xml
Improved Send Luxury tooltip
Hide Orders cost on "Add Urban" button
Selected tab is now un-highlighted when map search is open
Tribe opinion rate shown even when leader opinion modifiers sum to 0
Yield totals always shown in the stats screen, even when there is only one player shown on the graphs
